stories.title: Today’s NFL players grew up knowing about CTE: Here’s why they risk it to play
stories.summary: We asked over 30 NFL players about CTE concerns, and their answers ranged from fear to resignation.

stories.title: Would NFL players take a test that could diagnose CTE in the living?
stories.summary: Would players want to know if they have the disease? Some would and some wouldn't. Here's what they said.

stories.title: Sources: Zeitler latest vet added by Packers to aid besieged O-line
stories.summary: Veteran guard Kevin Zeitler is signing a one-year deal with the Packers, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Avs close door on coaching questions, sign Bednar through 2030-31
stories.summary: After he was set to coach on the final season of his contract, the Avalanche's Jared Bednar is getting a four-year extension.

stories.title: Schlittler, Rice author 'remarkable' night as Yankees roll in Game 1
stories.summary: Cam Schlittler pitched another playoff gem against the Red Sox and Ben Rice also burned their hometown team with a late grand slam and six RBIs as the Yankees opened this AL Wild Card Series rematch with a 9-0 victory.
